create_DummyGaitGenerator: create a DummyGaitGenerator instance with a quadruped robot and initial leg stance states
reset_DummyGaitGenerator: reset the DummyGaitGenerator leg states back to the initial standing configuration
get_desired_leg_state: get the desired SWING or STANCE states for all legs of the quadruped robot
set_desired_leg_state: set the desired leg states by assigning a new sequence of LegState values
get_leg_state: get the actual leg states after accounting for ground contact with the robot
